user.title: Vinyl ID
user.description: Adds a Record Player that shows the song, cover and progress of the record the Vinyl ID app hears.

data.url: Address of the Vinyl ID app
data.speaker: Speaker that plays your record (optional)
data.source_player: Player whose line-in the record is on (optional)

data_description.url: Leave as it is when the app runs on this Home Assistant. For the app on another machine: http://<that machine>:8780.
data_description.speaker: The speaker or amp you listen to records on. The Record Player's volume and power buttons control it. Leave empty to only show what is playing.
data_description.listener: The Music Assistant speaker named Vinyl ID Listener. It is hidden from dashboards, since it is not the player to look at. It keeps working and stays under Settings > Entities.
data_description.source_player: The Music Assistant player your turntable is plugged into, for example an Apollo CAST. When that player is idle, Vinyl ID starts its line-in and connects the silent speaker to it, also after restarts. It never takes the player away from other music.
data_description.source_name: The name of the line-in in that player's list of sources, exactly as written there. Open the player in Home Assistant to see the list.
data_description.monitor: Only for a player that has a setting to play its line-in either directly or in sync with other rooms, direct listed first. Vinyl ID then picks direct while only that player listens, and in sync when you group other speakers onto the record. Leave empty if your player has no such setting.

error.cannot_connect: No Vinyl ID app answered at that address. Check that the app is started; if it runs on another machine, use http://<that machine>:8780.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Vinyl ID is already set up.
